summary.text:
Rural Telehealth and Education Enhancement Act of 2025
This bill reauthorizes the Distance Learning and Telemedicine Program through FY2030. This Department of Agriculture program provides grants to help rural communities gain the technology and training necessary to engage in telemedicine and distance learning.

title: Rural Telehealth and Education Enhancement Act of 2025
